title: William Cook Holdings Limited
description:
[defence] William Cook Holdings Limited, trading as William Cook Group, is a privately owned UK industrial group founded in 1840 and headquartered at Parkway Avenue, Sheffield S9 4UL, England (Reg. No. 3283010). The group operates through four principal divisions: Cook Defence Systems (armoured vehicle track systems and structural components), William Cook Rail (bogie and coupler systems for trains), William Cook Cast Products (specialist steel castings for nuclear, energy, naval, and architectural applications), and William Cook Intermodal (container securing devices). The group employs approximately 470 people across three plants in Sheffield, Leeds, and Stanhope (County Durham). Chairman Sir Andrew Cook CBE is the fifth-generation family owner. HEICO Corporation (NYSE: HEI) holds a majority stake in Cook Defence Systems through its Defence Electronics division. Key customers include BAE Systems, Babcock, General Dynamics, Diehl Defence, Iveco Defence Vehicles, Rheinmetall, and multiple national ministries of defence.

The dataset comprises 1.1 TB exfiltrated from the Stanhope site file server (WC-STAN-FILE01), capturing the company's entire digital operational footprint across 59 top-level directories and approximately 1,400,000 files:

Employee personal data affecting an estimated 600-1,200 individuals: Powerhouse payroll database (967 MB, 6 backup sets with NI numbers, bank details, pay rates), 100+ named occupational health records (annual medicals, HAVS assessments, physio referrals, medical suspensions), 66+ employment liability claims, 3 employment tribunal cases, passport scan (Alex Kerr), 156 named employee folders, salary spreadsheets current to July 2024, P11D tax benefits-in-kind records, pension auto-enrolment data, and disciplinary records across 5 sites.

Complete financial records: TASBooks accounting backups (31 files spanning 2016-2022 for William Cook Leeds Ltd and William Cook Rail Ltd), management accounts FY24-FY26, Royal Bank of Scotland transaction history through August 2026 (July 2026: £3.68M credits, £2.81M debits), BACS payment runs, credit card expenditure, budgets and forecasts, and the CDS Master financial workbook. The Enquiry V3 Access database (55 MB) contains the complete commercial enquiry management system with customer intelligence, order history, and contact logs.

IT infrastructure reconnaissance data: 40 MB AccessEnum ACL dump of the entire file server share structure with Active Directory domain SIDs for both current (WILLIAMCOOK.LOCAL) and legacy (ASTRUM) domains, ESET endpoint security configuration with license key and PKCS#12 agent certificates, management server IPs for 3 sites, RDP configuration for Synchro ERP, VPN CA certificate (Astrum Main CA), and CWorks Plus CMMS maintenance management database with machine criticality ratings.

Privileged legal material: 3 employment tribunal cases (Atkinson K, Davies K, Swatten R), 66+ employer liability insurance claims, redundancy records (6 subdirectories), NDAs and cooperation agreements with Ukraine, Excalibur Army, FFG, Global Ordnance, and BASF, and Sir Andrew Cook's personal files including passport applications, property documents (5 Thurloe Street), and pension correspondence.
